text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Yuki has asked {0} to meet up with him.
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}はユキから呼び出されていた。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
There you are, {0}.
Are you all ready for our date?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さん、お待たせ。
それじゃあ
デートに行こうか？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
What? You didn't know it was a date? Don't get picky about the
wording. You get to spend time with me, which is all that
matters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
デートって言ってなかったっけ？
まぁ、
ボクとデートができるんだから、
細かいことなんて
どうでもいいよね？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: All right, so where should we—
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
まずはどこに──

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Aah! That's bright! Didn't this happen before?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ、
まぶしい……！？
これって、
この前の！？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Aaaugh!
text_block_list.orig_text: うわぁ～！

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
{0}, it's okay if you want to stare at me a lot more.
Let's make the most of our time together today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さん、せっかくボクと出かけてるんだから、
もっとボクのこと
見つめていいんだよ？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look at me. How could you not stare at me
every moment you get?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
こんなに可愛いんだから、
たくさん見ておいたほうがいいよ？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I think I get it. Could it be that you're so blinded by my
beauty that you need to look away once in a while?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
そうか！
ボクがまぶしすぎて、
目がくらみそうなんだね？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
I have that effect on people just by existing.
Poor little me and my sinful beauty.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただ存在してるだけで、
人を傷つけてしまう……
ああ、
ボクは
なんて罪深いんだろう。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why are you sighing? You're being kind of a drag today.
Maybe I should spend the day with someone else.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
なんでため息ついてるの？
……なんだか、
さっきからつれないね？
そんな態度が続くなら、
他の人に乗り換えちゃうよ？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
If I put my mind to it, someone will ask me out in
no time flat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクが本気を出せば、
すぐにナンパされちゃうんだから！

text_block_list.name: Flirt
text_block_list.text: Hey there, cutie! What's up?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
キミ！　かわいいね！

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, already? I wasn't even trying yet...
Can you believe my allure?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
もう来ちゃった……？
まだアピールもしてないのに……
さすがボクだね！

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
When you're as adorable as I am, people are just drawn to you,
I guess. Don't you think so too, {0}?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクくらい可愛いと、
アピールする必要もないんだよ。
{0}さんもそう思うでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Flirt
text_block_list.text:
Eh? You're with someone? Lame.
Why don't you ditch that loser and
let me show you a good time?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
なんだ男連れかよ……
そんなさえない奴より、
俺と遊ぼうぜ？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Really? I don't know... I'm really attached to {0}.
We've even held hands in the nude. Hee hee.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー、
どうしようかなぁ。
ボクと{0}さんの絆は深いからね。
だって、
裸で触れ合った仲だもん……
うふっ。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Aww, {0}! You look so flustered!
You are too precious!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やん、
{0}さんったら、
照れちゃって可愛い！

text_block_list.name: Flirt
text_block_list.text:
What the hell?! Don't ignore me while you
shamelessly flirt with your stupid date!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおいおい！
俺を無視してイチャコラしてんじゃねぇ！

text_block_list.name: Flirt
text_block_list.text:
I can hold hands in the nude too, you know!
Here, I'll show you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうなったら
俺も裸で触れ合ってやる！
こっちに来やがれっ！

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Noooo. {0}, heeelp!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやぁん～
{0}さん、助けてぇ～

text_block_list.name: Flirt
text_block_list.text:
You got something to say?
I'm sick of jerks like you, getting lucky
while guys like me strike out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ、
邪魔しようってのか？
自分ばっかりいい思いしやがって！
てめぇには容赦しねぇぞ！

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't fight!
Stop fighting over me!
choice_data_list: This is your fault, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お願い、
ケンカは止めて！
ボクのために争わないで！

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, don't you love my pleading voice?
But really, you shouldn't fight over me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
ボクの美声で
耳が溶けそうなんだね？
でも、
ボクのためなら黙っていられないよ！

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
My fault? Oh, because I'm so irresistible.
Is that what you meant?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうか……
ボクが美しすぎるせい……
そう言いたいんだね？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
That's right! This is all because of my fathomless beauty!
These perfect looks of mine are to blame...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう！　
ボクがこんなに
可愛いから、
いけないんだ！
あぁ、
ボクはなんて
罪深いんだ……

text_block_list.name: Flirt
text_block_list.text:
Both of you, shut the hell up!
You're seriously asking for a beatdown!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前ら、
ごちゃごちゃうるせぇ！
こうなったら力ずくで、
言うこと聞かせてやる！

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, we made him mad...
I don't think we can talk our way out of this one.
And I don't want to see you getting hurt, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわっ、
怒っちゃったよ……
話し合いでは解決できそうにないね。
{0}さんが傷つくのは嫌だな……

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What are you doing, {0}?
Why are you grabbing my hand?
choice_data_list: Let's make a run for it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
ちょっと{0}さん、
どうしたの？
なんでボクの手つかむの？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you took my hand so we can run away...
O-okay. Let's run.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか、
逃げるために……
……う、
うん。
わかった。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Just don't let go of my hand, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクの手、
絶対に
離さないでね？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...
We managed to escape. When you're as beautiful as me, you run
into trouble like that sometimes. It's a pain.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、はぁ、はぁ……
なんとか
逃げられたね。
可愛すぎると、
こういうことがあるから大変だよ。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
My exquisite beauty is both a blessing and a curse
from the heavens. I can't help it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
これは美しすぎるボクに課せられた
天からの
罰のようなものだからね。
仕方ないよ……

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: There is nothing on this planet that is as charming as I am!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクより魅力的なものなんて、
この世には存在していないんだからね！

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but... You did look rather handsome
while you were pulling me along by the hand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
でも……
ボクの手を引っ張っている時のキミ……
ちょっとだけ
カッコよかったよ。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: I hope you never let me go again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからもボクの手、
絶対に
離さないでね？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: And that's that. Welcome back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
お疲れさま。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
What you just saw was basically a dream.
Once you wake up, you'll probably forget that you saw it.
Don't worry too much about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたが今、
見てたのは夢みたいなものよ。
目覚めたらすぐに忘れちゃうと思うし、
今はあんまり気にしなくてもいいわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Yuki from the \"other side\" is exactly the same
as the one \"here\", huh.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかしユキちゃんは
『あっち』でも『こっち』でも
まったくブレないわね……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
He has no problem stringing people along
and causing trouble, because he knows he's
the cutest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分は誰よりも可愛い。
一番可愛いから、
みんなを振り回しても
迷惑をかけちゃっても問題ない、
って感じ？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: It's kind of scary how committed he is to believing that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それを一切疑うことなく信じ切ってるから
怖いのよねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I guess being vain isn't such a bad thing.
I might even envy him a little.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
そういう図々しいところも
あの子の良い所だし、
うらやましいと言えばうらやましいけどね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
That's enough meaningless chitchat. I'll let you get back
to your regular programming.
See you again! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
あんまり無駄話してても仕方ないし、
今回はこのくらいにしておくわ。
じゃあね～♪

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Are you finally awake, {0}?
I think we both fell asleep again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さん、やっと起きたね？
ボクたち、
また寝ちゃってたみたいだよ。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
I had the weirdest dream. A man was hitting on me,
but then you rescued me, {0}...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでね、
不思議な夢を見たんだ。
{0}さんが、
ナンパ男から助けてくれる夢……

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
I knew it. You had the same dream, didn't you?
Hehe. You and I are so connected.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり{0}さんも
同じ夢を見てたの？
ふふっ、
やっぱりボクたち、
心が通じ合っているんだね。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Oops, I almost forgot. We were in the middle of a date.
We've lost some precious time, so let's get going.
Are you ready?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、
いけない。
デートをするんだったね。
眠っていたせいで、
時間を無駄にしちゃったね。
早く行こうか？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wait! {0}! I wanna hold hands with you
while we walk together today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
{0}さん、待って！
ボク、
きょうは手をつないで歩きたいな～

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Hee hee. Don't ever let go of my hand again, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふっ、
ボクの手、
絶対に離さないでね？
